applyTo: "**/*.py,**/*.md,**/*.ipynb"
description: "Documentation requirements and standards"
---

# Documentation Standards

## Code Documentation
- Use docstrings for all public functions, classes, and modules
- Follow Google-style or NumPy-style docstring format
- Include parameter types, return types, and example usage
- Document exceptions that may be raised

## MCP Server Documentation
- Document tool descriptions clearly - they appear in Copilot UI
- Include example usage for each MCP tool
- Document server configuration options and transport modes
- Provide setup and testing instructions

## Markdown Documentation
- Use clear headings and consistent formatting
- Include code examples with syntax highlighting
- Add table of contents for longer documents
- Link between related documentation files

## Jupyter Notebook Standards
- Use markdown cells to explain the purpose of each code section
- Include clear outputs and visualizations
- Add a summary cell at the end of complex notebooks
- Document data sources and methodology

## API Documentation
- Document all public APIs with clear examples
- Include error handling and edge cases
- Provide integration examples and troubleshooting tips
- Keep documentation up-to-date with code changes
